About

Who I Am

I'm a Computer Science student at Farmingdale State College, specializing in software engineering. I'm passionate about writing clean, efficient code and understanding how systems work under the hood.

My coursework spans Java programming (concurrency, JavaFX, data structures), computer networking, and software design. I enjoy solving algorithmic problems and building applications from scratch.

Outside of class I stay sharp through competitive gaming, personal projects, and keeping up with industry trends. Currently exploring full-stack development and looking for internship opportunities where I can contribute and grow.
